title: Mem2A dossier
description: What memory tells an agent before it acts. Sent by memory as the single data part (mediaType `application/vnd.mem2a.dossier+json`) of the task artifact with artifactId `dossier`. Replaced whole, with a new version, whenever it changes.

summary.description: A short brief an agent or a person can read at a glance, for example `Hold the quote: legal paused Acme pricing on Friday.`

watching.description: Exactly the ids of the facts, precedent and constraints in this dossier: memory watches them, and a change to any of them produces a new dossier version and an update.

expiresAt.description: When memory will stop watching if the agent has not committed. Present whenever memory declares a `watchTimeout`.
